# James Moore & Co.

> > A full-service CPA and accounting firm providing tax, assurance, accounting, and business advisory services to organizations nationwide from their Gainesville base.

James Moore & Co. is a comprehensive CPA firm specializing in tax preparation, audit and assurance services, outsourced accounting, and strategic business advisory. They serve diverse industries including healthcare, collegiate athletics, nonprofits, and startups, with particular expertise in SBIR grant accounting and NCAA compliance.
